provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A CORS preflight that accepts every request header removes the server's allow-list, so it must be reported.

groundTruth.rationale: Access-Control-Allow-Headers is exactly the wildcard, so any header name a caller invents is accepted for the origins the policy admits. The restriction the allow-list would provide is absent.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live preflight.
The rule does not read the allowed origins, so the case does not claim which origins can use the wildcard.
